main_text.l: obsederit eam inimicus eius interra portarum suarum, quæcunqꝫ plaga, & quæcunqꝫ infirmitas.

29. Quæcunqꝫ oratio, aut quæcun-que deprecatio quæ suscepta fuerit à quocunque homine, aut ab vniuerso populo tuo Israele, cum agnouerit quisqꝫ plagam suam, & dolorem suū, & expanderit manus suas in domo ista.
30. Tu exaudies de cœlo habitacu-lo sessionis tuæ, ac parcas, ac des vnicuique iuxta vias suas, quia nosti cor eius, tu enim solus nosti cor filiorum hominum.
31. Ut timeant te, ut ambulent in viis tuis omnibus diebus, quibus vi-xerint, super faciem terræ, quam dedisti patribus nostris.

l.i: Salomon sapientiæ & pietatis nomine clarissimus rex, extructo & perfecto templo Ierosolymitano, illud piis & artendibus [?] precibus ad Deum,

page.notes: The first word of the italic paragraph is printed as a woodcut initial S followed by "alomon"; it is given here as "Salomon". The catchword "præsenti" is at the lower right below the last line and is kept out of the text. The verse numbers 29, 30 and 31 are set in the text and kept as printed. Changes made: "vt" to "ut", "vijs" to "viis", "pijs" to "piis" (i/j rule); long s printed as s. "artendibus" is the printed reading and is doubtful, marked [?]. "interra" is printed as such.
